mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_name, password, riyousha_cd, research_type, authority_cd, failed_count, account_locked, password_expired, delete_flag FROM m_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_flag = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE m_user SET failed_count = failed_count + 1, account_locked = CASE WHEN failed_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN TRUE ELSE account_locked END, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE m_user SET failed_count = 0, account_locked = FALSE, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE m_user SET account_locked = TRUE, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
